description:
[0.98a] AutoTrader v0.0.1

Sell your extra weapons and buy hullmods you don't know whenever you dock

AutoTrader runs your standing buy/sell rules the moment you open a planet's interaction dialog. Set a sell threshold for that Light Machine Gun you keep accumulating, a buy threshold for Heavy Needlers, tell it to grab any modspec you haven't learned.

Access the configuration menu through the AutoTrader intel, which is found in the Trade tab in the intel screen.

Features

Per-item thresholds. For every weapon and fighter wing in the game, set "sell above N" and "buy below N". Leave either blank to skip that direction.
Runs on first approach. Transactions happen the moment the planet dialog opens, so when you click into the market screen, your inventory already reflects what AutoTrader did. A per-stack log line is posted for every sale and purchase.
Hullmod hunting. Optionally buy unknown modspecs (open market, black market, or both) and auto-learn them on the spot.
Decent QoL. A custom configuration screen accessible from the intel tab: filter by text search, size/type, or only the items that you hold. Multi-select with an option to apply a template to your full selection at once, and a "Set Reasonable Defaults" button for quick first-time setup.

No dependencies. Should be safe to add mid-save. Not safe to remove, but can be completely disabled from the config menu.

Download: GitHub

AI Usage Disclosure: Most of this mod's code was generated using Claude Opus 4.7
